task_title: Implement King Skritt ROMAN-CANDLE CORONATION boss ability

plan_review.notes: Plan posted as issue comment on #1955 before any code was written. Followed the established verdigris-glamour/bamboo-fed-berserk/undercity-mob-call pattern: typed adapter reads specific catalog fields and provides a named resolve handler to the generic executor. Key decisions confirmed: (1) new MobAbilityRadialProjectilesGeometry type in types.ts, (2) alternation via resolvedCasts % 2 in runtime.ts beginTelegraph, (3) resolve handler launches 12 spawnEnemyProjectile calls along committed spoke angles, (4) arena preset via spawnFromArchetype pattern, (5) VFX added to MobAbilityVfx.ts drawRadialTelegraph/spawnCoronationBurst. No alternatives proposed that would diverge from the established pattern.
